# PeerJS 1.5.5

Vendored unchanged from the official `peerjs` npm package, MIT licensed.
Source: https://github.com/peers/peerjs
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/peerjs/-/peerjs-1.5.5.tgz
Package SHA-512 integrity verified before extraction:
`sha512-viMUCPDL6CSfOu0ZqVcFqbWRXNHIbv2lPqNbrBIjbFYrflebOjItJ4hPfhjnuUCstqciHVu9vVJ7jFqqKi/EuQ==`

Loaded only when the player creates or joins an online room. The client is served from this repository, not a runtime CDN. The explicit ICE configuration in network.js overrides PeerJS's bundled defaults. No embedded TURN credentials are used.
